name: MIRE-7: Unexpected Memory Value Write or Modification
description: A destructive on-board command (memory poke, EEPROM-write enable, integrity-monitor disable, clock set) observed on the command feed, matched against the core hazardous-command catalog. Surfaces the destructive command regardless of who issued it, including a wire injection.
query:
FROM logs.ecs.spacecraft.commands
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hour AND command.name IS NOT NULL
| LOOKUP JOIN ref-hazardous-command ON command.name
| WHERE hazardous == "true"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, target_name, command.name, reason, criticality
| LIMIT 100
author: Elastic
false_positives: Authorized scheduled memory maintenance issues the same commands. Tune per mission via detection exceptions at deployment.

## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
An ES|QL rule over the command feed that joins each command against the core hazardous-command catalog and flags any match, surfacing destructive commanding on the wire. Operator attribution is performed separately by the AI agent from the portal registration log.

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Execution
- **Technique EX-0012:** [Modify On-Board Values](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0012/)
- **Indicator of Behavior MIRE-7:** Unexpected write or modification of on-board memory/configuration values.

### Indicators of Behavior
- **MIRE-7: Unexpected write or modification of on-board memory/configuration values.**

### How to validate this alert
Confirm command.name is in the hazardous-command catalog. Correlate with the on-board IDS alert and the telemetry effects, and ask the AI agent to attribute the command to a registered operator via the portal log. See spartastixkb for countermeasures.

### References
- https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0012/
